body: Can we do the check about props. searchForFacetValues here rather than inside renderSearchBox?

When reading this part, I wonder if `Highlight` should maybe automatically fallback to the non highlighted form by default.

What do you think?

Since inside transform items we allow users to completely change the items, I would say once the user provides a transformItems method we do not slice based on the limit and we warn that using limit AND transform items is not compatible.

Otherwise we will have usages like:

```
RefinementList
  transformItems=...
  limit=Infinity
```

Plus the fact that it does not make sense to allow the user doing a full filter and map on the whole items to then ditch items he mapped (If this is not clear, yell at me) :D

After second thought, the behaviour you implemented is the right one because when being given items to reorder, you do need to loop through ALL of them before being able to display only ten of them so we are safe in doing this slice AFTER transformItems
Second read: this is not an issue of always using Highlight but an issue of switching to isSearch ? `<Highlight..` : item.label;
